softwareSummary: 46/46 Node tests and 46/46 real Chromium checks passed in this edition. Replay, exports, import, map selection, cancellation, and a 390 px viewport were exercised. Direct file launch and other browser engines are not verified here.
channelSummary: 32 independent SciPy channel protocols were compared at each of two timesteps. At 0.005 ms: maximum state error 2.657e-07; maximum current error 1.387e-05 nA per µS. These are numerical comparisons, not new biological validation.
couplingSummary: Six frozen-state cable probes agreed with independently assembled SciPy sparse solves within 2.274e-13 mV. Default train: 3 events / 3 pulses, no extras. Maximum checked KCL residual 1.883e-12 nA. A finer mesh shifted a single-pulse event by 0.220 ms, with 2.80 mV waveform RMS change; full mesh convergence and independent combined-model validation remain pending.
